items.item: Certificate / Articles of Incorporation (+ all amendments)
items.description: Charter establishing legal existence and authorized shares.
Internal governance rules and officer/director authority.

items.item: Certificates of Designation / rights & preferences of preferred stock
items.description: Terms of each preferred series defining investor rights.
Evidence every issuance, grant, hire, and major action was properly authorized.
Shareholder approvals such as charter amendments and pool increases.
State confirmation the entity is active and compliant.
Registrations to operate in each state where the company does business.

items.item: Organizational chart of legal entities / subsidiaries
items.description: Corporate structure including subsidiaries and foreign entities.
Federal employer identification verification for the entity.
Confirms legal authority to operate in its jurisdiction/industry.
Pending or threatened suits, settlements, and government investigations.
Certifies officers and signing authority at loan closing.
Specific board approval to enter the facility; standard closing condition.
Definitive agreements for each equity financing closed.
Convertible instruments and their caps/discounts/conversion terms.
Debt instruments converting to equity; interest, maturity, cap.
Terms agreed in earlier rounds; precedent terms.

items.item: Investor rights / voting / co-sale / ROFR agreements
items.description: Ongoing investor protective, consent, and information rights.
Special rights granted to specific investors (MFN, pro-rata, info).

items.item: Fundraising history schedule (amounts, dates, valuations, investors)
items.description: Capital raised history and post-money valuations.
All holders, ownership %, options, warrants, convertibles on as-converted basis.
Ownership evolution and modeled post-financing ownership.
Authoritative record of every issuance, transfer, and repurchase.

items.item: Shareholder & optionee list (issuance dates, original price)
items.description: Holder-level detail of every security owner.

items.item: Stock option / equity incentive plan documents
items.description: Governing plan for the option pool.
Individual grant terms, strike prices, vesting.

items.item: Vesting schedules (all stock & options, incl. acceleration)
items.description: Vesting status and any single/double-trigger acceleration terms.

items.item: Restricted stock purchase / founder stock agreements
items.description: Founder share purchases and their vesting/repurchase terms.
Rights to purchase shares, often issued with debt or to vendors.
Authorized vs granted vs available pool and overhang.
Documentation of early exercises and unvested-share repurchases.
Independent fair value of common stock supporting strike prices and warrant pricing.
Issuances, transfers, and dilution over time.
Rollover equity and post-close MIP/option pool structure.
Revenue, costs, and profitability over time.
Assets, liabilities, and equity position.
Operating/investing/financing cash movement.

items.item: Monthly net burn rate & cash runway
items.description: Net cash consumed per month and months of cash remaining.
Liquidity on hand across all accounts.

items.item: Financial model / 3-5 year projections (revenue, hiring, cost, use of funds)
items.description: Forward plan with assumptions and sensitivity, tested against historicals.
Forecasting accuracy and management credibility.

items.item: Revenue breakdown by customer / segment / product
items.description: Revenue concentration and mix.
Unit-level profitability and COGS structure.
Collection and payment health (DSO/DPO inputs).
Independently verified statements (expected at Series B+, PE/M&A, IPO).
How the raise or facility proceeds will be deployed.

items.item: Chart of accounts & GL detail export
items.description: Underlying ledger detail for quality-of-earnings and journal-entry testing.
Account-level balances reconciled to statements.
Where company cash and payments flow; completeness-of-rails check.
Walk from reported EBITDA to normalized EBITDA supporting every adjustment.
Itemized non-recurring, owner-related, and discretionary add-backs.
Adjusts above/below-market owner salary, perks, and personal expenses to market.
Isolates subsidies, one-off contracts, litigation, restructuring, and deal costs.
Annualizes new contracts, price increases, headcount, and acquisitions to a run-rate.
Confirms timing/method, cutoff, and that growth is real vs pulled-forward.
Ties bank deposits/disbursements to reported P&L to detect manipulation.
How much EBITDA converts to cash after working capital, capex, and unusual items.
Non-GAAP operating KPIs that drive the business.
Monthly current assets less current liabilities; basis for the NWC analysis.
Normalized WC level the seller must deliver at close.

items.item: DSO / DPO / DIO & cash conversion cycle
items.description: Working-capital efficiency metrics and trend (manipulation flags).
Unearned obligations often treated as debt-like (work already paid for).
Composition of prepaids/accruals affecting normalized WC.
All interest-bearing debt plus debt-like items reducing equity value.
Total debt net of unrestricted cash for the EV-to-equity bridge.
Pre-close comp accruals and deal/stay bonuses treated as debt-like.
Lease obligations classified as debt.
Intercompany/affiliate balances and unrecorded obligations.
Enterprise value less net debt and WC adjustments to equity value.

items.item: Capex history & maintenance vs. growth capex
items.description: Capex run-rate and split to assess true maintenance capex.
Inventory composition, obsolescence reserves, DIO.
Monthly revenue series to model growth and seasonality.
Recurring revenue base; primary advance-rate and growth driver.
Decomposition of recurring-revenue movement showing growth quality.
Revenue lost from existing customers; core risk metric.
Expansion-net-of-churn on the installed base; top SaaS metric.
Percentage of customers lost per period; product-market-fit signal.
Retention/revenue by acquisition cohort over time; LTV durability.
Revenue share from largest customers; key credit and deal risk.
Customer lifetime value vs acquisition cost; unit-economics health.
Cost and months to recover customer acquisition; efficiency measure.

items.item: Burn multiple (net burn ÷ net new ARR)
items.description: Capital efficiency of growth; lower is better.
Average revenue per user/account; pricing-power indicator.
Contracted-but-unbilled and weighted pipeline validating forward revenue.
Quality and repeatability of the top line.
Geographic/segment concentration and exposure.
ARR generated per S&M dollar; GTM scalability.
Balance of growth rate and margin.
Price realization, discount trends, and pricing power.
Evidence of real product engagement.

items.item: E-commerce platform sales data (orders, AOV, refunds)
items.description: Shopify/Amazon sales and return rates; core to e-commerce RBF underwriting.
Ad performance and analytics driving revenue (Wayflyer-style underwriting).
Verifies deposits, balances, and cash-flow consistency.

items.item: Average monthly deposits / bank revenue run-rate
items.description: Deposit consistency underpinning RBF advance sizing.
Tri-party agreement giving lender control over accounts to perfect security interest.
Returned-item and overdraft incidents signaling cash stress.
Reconciliations supporting proof-of-cash and statement integrity.
Largest revenue agreements, terms, and termination/assignment clauses.
Evidence of contracted recurring revenue for advance sizing.
Critical supply relationships, terms, and concentration.
Facility leases and fixed-asset register.
Contracts requiring consent on a transaction.
Intercompany and insider contracts to be normalized.
Channel economics and dependencies.
Terms, covenants, and change-of-control on existing debt.
Top customers and dependence risk.
Weighted pipeline and conversion outlook.
Customers the investor can call to validate value.
Contract length, auto-renewal, and termination rights driving retention.
Confirms founders assigned all IP to the company — the #1 legal red flag if missing.
Every employee assigned IP and agreed to confidentiality.

items.item: Contractor / consultant IP assignment & confidentiality agreements
items.description: Anyone who created IP assigned it to the company.
Issued/pending patents and freedom-to-operate.
Brand/name protections owned.
Registered creative or software works.

items.item: Inbound / outbound IP licenses & technology agreements
items.description: Licenses to/from third parties affecting IP ownership.
OSS components and license obligations (copyleft risk).
Owned digital assets.
Planned features aligned with strategy.
System design and scalability.

items.item: Technical due-diligence package (code quality, security, infra)
items.description: Engineering health and tech-debt assessment.
DR/BC plans and last-test results.
Least-privilege, MFA, and zero-trust posture.

items.item: Employee & consultant census (title, comp, bonus, classification, location)
items.description: Full roster with compensation and exempt/non-exempt status.

items.item: Org chart / headcount by function (current + projected)
items.description: Team structure and scaling plan.
Terms binding key personnel.
Founder roles, comp, and commitments.
Contractor terms and misclassification risk.
Planned roles tied to the raise.

items.item: Employee benefit / retirement plans (incl. determination letters, SPDs)
items.description: Benefit arrangements, funding status, and qualification.
Termination obligations and stay incentives.
Variable-comp structures and accrued amounts.
Policy framework and labor-compliance posture.
Background of founders/executives for execution-risk assessment.
Wages, bonuses, and commissions feeding comp normalization.
Filed federal returns corroborating reported revenue and income.

items.item: State / local income & franchise tax returns
items.description: Multi-jurisdiction income/franchise filings.

items.item: Sales & use tax compliance & multi-state nexus analysis
items.description: Sales-tax compliance and exposure where the company doesn't file.
Withholding/remittance and worker-classification exposure.
Eligibility and claimed R&D credits.
Quantifies surviving NOLs/credits after an ownership change.
Cross-border pricing and foreign tax exposure.
Open audits and estimated exposure.
Restricted-stock tax elections filed within 30 days of grant; common compliance gap.

items.item: Proof of tax-payment status / no tax liens
items.description: Confirms taxes are current; tax liens prime lender collateral.

items.item: Personal tax returns of owners / guarantors
items.description: For owner-guaranteed facilities, verifies personal income/assets.

items.item: Existing debt schedule (lender, balance, rate, maturity, collateral)
items.description: All outstanding debt to assess leverage and lien priority.
Defines lien priority among multiple lenders; closing condition where other debt exists.

items.item: Payoff letters for debt being refinanced
items.description: Confirms amount to retire prior debt at closing.
Guarantees, earnouts, and contingencies not on the balance sheet.
Existing filings against the company to confirm clear collateral.
Perfects the lender's all-assets security interest.
Borrower schedule of legal name, locations, accounts, IP, and assets for perfection.
Eligible-collateral calc (AR/inventory) setting the available draw amount.
Tangible assets available as collateral.
Third-party waivers so the lender can access collateral at leased premises.
Identity of beneficial owners per FinCEN/AML rules; required to onboard.
Identity verification of control persons.
Confirms the borrowing entity exists and matches records.
Screens owners and entity against sanctions and watchlists.
Consent to pull personal credit, weighted heavily for startups.
Entity credit history (D&B/Experian) for risk scoring.
Financial-crime and corruption controls.
Proof of liability coverage protecting the business and collateral.

items.item: Property / hazard insurance with lender as loss payee
items.description: Coverage on collateral naming the lender as loss payee.
Coverage on directors/officers required by many VD lenders and investors.
Coverage for data-breach and cyber liability.
Claims history and coverage adequacy.
Public-facing legal terms and data handling.
Data-protection compliance for EU/CA data subjects.
Security posture; effectively required for enterprise B2B sales.
Security controls and breach record.
Required operating licenses (fintech/health, etc.).
Environmental obligations and HSE records.
Sized opportunity and capturable share.
Differentiation vs competitors.
Key-supplier dependency and continuity risk.
Throughput, utilization, and unit-economics drivers.
Product-quality and warranty-claim trends.
Narrative of vision, product, market, traction, team, and ask.
Concise company overview for initial screening.
Read-only API connections enabling automated underwriting and verification.
Confirmation of investor support, central to venture-debt credit decisions.

items.item: Ongoing reporting covenant package (monthly financials, compliance cert, borrowing base)
items.description: Post-close recurring deliverables required by the facility.
